task_description: Upgrade frontend-mythos skill with autonomous Playwright visual verification runner (scripts/visual-verify.ts), aesthetic benchmarks (references/aesthetic-benchmarks.md), common layout pitfalls and repair strategies (references/common-layout-pitfalls.md), and self-correcting 4-stage loop in SKILL.md.

changes_made.summary: Implemented deterministic headless Playwright runner with 4-stage readiness check (network stabilization with fallback, target selector hydration, document.fonts.ready, requestAnimationFrame frame flush, and console/hydration error interception), multi-viewport screenshot capture (desktop, tablet, mobile), and report.json output.

Codified layout heuristics from industry-defining design systems: Linear (8pt baseline grid, subtle micro-borders, shortcut kbd chips), Stripe (tabular numeric alignment, canvas temperature, subtle dot badges), and Vercel (zero horizontal jitter, container bounds, vertical doubling hierarchy).

Created comprehensive layout pitfalls reference covering React SSR hydration desync, mobile flex squishing, FOIT/CLS shifts, invisible focus outline erasure, text truncation min-w-0 collapse, z-index collisions, warped radii, and horizontal scrollbar leaks with autonomous repair actions.

Upgraded skill definition to integrate the 4-Stage Autonomous Execution Loop (Implementation, Capture & Wait, Visual Inspection & Heuristic Audit, Self-Correction), key failure modes table, and synchronized Level 3 references.
Mirrored upgraded scripts, references, and SKILL.md to project root .claude/skills/frontend-mythos/.
Mirrored upgraded scripts, references, and SKILL.md to user config directory for global agent discovery.
